test_title: PYST 37: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 20 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A and B complete a work in 15 days. If A alone can do it in 17 days, then B alone can do two-third of the same work in _______ days.
solution:
**Given:**

A and B together complete work in 15 days.

A alone = 17 days.

**Formula used:**

Total Work = LCM of (15, 17)

Work rate = Work ÷ Time

**Calculation:**

LCM(15, 17) = 255 units (Total Work)

Work rate of A+B = 255 ÷ 15 = 17 units/day

Work rate of A = 255 ÷ 17 = 15 units/day

Work rate of B = 17 - 15 = 2 units/day

B’s time for 2/3 work = (2/3 × 255) ÷ 2 = 170 ÷ 2 = 85 days

**∴ B alone can do two-third of the work in 85 days.**
